data.rationale: The proposal has the right pieces (Monthly tab, search text, date gridcell, Update Search) but in a wrong, rotated order (date and update before the tab and typing). It also hardcodes the date and a "Florida Keys" suggestion, names no parameters, and leaves out the date-picker open step, so it can't be automated as written.
